"By every means I shall today conquer all the Pāṇḍavas, gathered together." ‖ 58
Duryodhana said:
"I will do all this just as you think fit, Karṇa.
Chariots stocked with quivers will follow you in person, O son of a charioteer. ‖ 59
Let carts carry iron shafts and vulture-feathered arrows for you.

<column-break/>

We will follow you, Karṇa, we and all the kings." ‖ 60
Sañjaya said:
Having spoken thus, great king, your mighty son,
the king, approached the king of the Madras and spoke these words. ‖ 61 <note>The king of the Madras is Śalya, whom Duryodhana is about to ask to serve as Karṇa's charioteer.</note>

->Thus ends the twenty-second chapter of the Karṇa Parvan in the glorious Mahābhārata. ‖ 22 ‖<-

---

Sañjaya said:
Your son, great king, to the king of the Madras these words,
